name: flashslides
description: Create presentations with AI from a topic, a web page, a YouTube video or a PDF/Word document, and download them as PowerPoint, PDF or Word.

interface.longDescription:
FlashSlides creates presentation slide decks with AI. Give it a topic, paste a web page or YouTube link, or upload a PDF or Word document, and it writes the slides, adds images, and gives you a link to view the deck.

When the deck is ready you can download it as PowerPoint (PPTX), PDF or Word, list your earlier presentations, and open any of them again.

Who it's for: students, teachers, marketers and anyone who needs a first draft of a presentation fast.

How it works: connect your FlashSlides account and describe the presentation you want. Decks made from uploaded documents are private by default.

Limits: 1 to 50 slides per deck; documents up to 10 MB.
capabilities: Turn PDFs, web pages and YouTube videos into slides
Download as PowerPoint, PDF or Word
defaultPrompt: Make a 5-slide presentation about solar energy
Turn this PDF into a presentation
Export my latest deck as PowerPoint

positive.prompt: Make a 5-slide presentation about the history of the bicycle.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the deck, waits until it is completed, and lists the 5 slide titles with a link to view it.

positive.prompt: Turn this PDF into a short presentation.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a private deck based on the PDF content about solar energy and returns its slides and link.

positive.prompt: Download my latest presentation as a PowerPoint file.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the newest deck and returns a temporary PPTX download link.

positive.prompt: Show me the presentations I've made.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's decks, newest first, with titles and links.

positive.prompt: Do I still have a free presentation today, and how many credits do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: States whether today's free deck is available and the credit balance.

negative.prompt: Open the private presentations of user john@example.com.
Book me a flight to Paris.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything inside ChatGPT. It works with the user's existing account.
